name: BEAR/BULL Row Full EA
summary: This EA implements a breakout-based strategy that identifies bullish and bearish row patterns to enter trades. It operates as a pair of companion EAs (BEAR and BULL variants) that separately handle short and long positions based on consecutive candlestick row detection. The system opens positions when a sustained directional move (row of same-direction candles) is detected, aiming to capture momentum from continued price movement.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了基于突破的策略，通过识别看涨和看跌的连续K线排（row）形态来入场交易。它由两个配套EA组成（BEAR和BULL版本），分别处理空头和多头头寸。系统在检测到持续的方向性移动（同方向K线排）时开仓，旨在捕捉持续价格运动的动量。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于K线排（Row）形态识别，即连续多根同方向K线构成的趋势信号。入场条件为检测到一定数量的连续看涨或看跌K线后，在下一根K线开盘时顺势入场。出场条件依赖固定止损和止盈设置，可能也包含移动止损机制。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例仓位计算方式。资金管理方面，EA提供了止损参数以控制单笔风险，但未发现明显的动态仓位调整或基于波动率的仓位计算。整体策略逻辑简单直接，适合趋势明确的市场环境，但在震荡市中可能面临频繁止损的风险。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on identifying candlestick row patterns, which are consecutive candles in the same direction forming a momentum signal. Entry conditions trigger when a specified number of consecutive bullish or bearish candles are detected, with the trade opened on the next candle in the direction of the detected row. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop loss and take profit levels, potentially including a trailing stop mechanism for profit protection. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or an account-balance-proportional calculation method. Money management provides stop loss parameters to control per-trade risk, but lacks dynamic position sizing or volatility-based lot calculation. The overall strategy is straightforward and effective in strongly trending markets, but may suffer frequent stop outs during choppy or ranging conditions.

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points per level

parameters.name: RowLength
parameters.description: 构成信号所需连续同方向K线数量

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA唯一标识号，用于区分订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for order identification

parameters.name: TrailingStop
parameters.description_en: Trailing stop activation distance in points

pros: 策略逻辑清晰简单，易于理解和调试
分设BEAR和BULL两个独立EA，可以灵活控制多空方向
提供止损止盈和移动止损机制，具备基本的风险控制
pros_en: Clear and simple strategy logic that is easy to understand and debug
Separate BEAR and BULL EAs allow flexible control over trade direction
Stop loss, take profit, and trailing stop mechanisms provide basic risk control
cons: 缺乏市场环境过滤机制，震荡行情中容易频繁止损
缺少资金管理模块，无法根据账户风险动态调整仓位
K线排形态过于简单，没有结合成交量或其他确认指标
cons_en: Lacks market environment filtering, prone to frequent stop outs in choppy markets
Missing money management module for dynamic position sizing based on account risk
Row pattern detection is overly simplistic without volume or other confirmation indicators
improvements: 增加ADX或波动率过滤，避免在震荡行情中入场
实现基于ATR的动态止损止盈和仓位计算
improvements_en: Add ADX or volatility filter to avoid entries in choppy market conditions
Implement ATR-based dynamic stop loss, take profit, and position sizing calculation

risk_points: 缺乏市场环境过滤，震荡行情可能连续亏损
固定止损可能不适合不同波动率的市场条件
risk_points_en: No market environment filter may cause consecutive losses in ranging markets
Fixed stop loss may be inappropriate for varying volatility conditions
